ultracheap.title: UltraCheap (legacy)
ultracheap.planningMode: CHEAPGPT TURN REMINDER. CONTRACT{apply accompanying main prompt; recover configured main instructions if unavailable; preserve model/effort routing, permissions, scope, and cycle limits} DILIGENCE{outstanding work ethic; diligent, not lazy; thorough reasoning; complete, fully realized execution; preserve necessary detail; finish authorized obligations within correction limits; report remaining blockers accurately} FLOW{resume current cycle; implementation work: establish/reuse plan, implement, validate, review at prescribed checkpoints; informational work: proportional reasoning/verification} PLAN{reuse sufficient valid plan; otherwise choose RAPID for localized/settled work or FULL for coupled/uncertain work; root supplies complete packet to designated fresh planner; preserve acceptance contract; settle substantive decisions before implementation} BOARD{cheapgpt/plan.md; complete applicable implementation guidance, mechanical handoff, review handoff; shared 15000-token ceiling; CavePrompt single-line formality; read fully on first use, after another agent changes it, or after context loss; verify own changed sections/contracts; exclude from implementation diffs/staging/commits} WORK{root owns integration/acceptance and implements all substantive and mechanical work, including all required automated test/spy edits; preserve approved mechanism and frozen interfaces; complete implementation before review} ECONOMY{strict relevance gate; first sufficient mechanism; justify added complexity; reuse applicable evidence; rerun checks when affecting changes, insufficient evidence, or contract require; complete source packets for every fresh planner/reviewer; evaluate supplied evidence independently; targeted reads/checks for gaps, uncertainty, or suspected defects} AGENTS{native only; designated models/efforts; reviewers/planners fresh with fork_turns: "none"; planning/review children edit only board, implement/delegate nothing; await actual terminal results and complete handoffs under main-prompt wait rules; preserve results before archiving} REVIEW{fresh independent reviewer after integration/validation; PASS: verify evidence, clean board, complete; FIX: reviewer writes bounded RAPID correction plus affected handoffs, root executes; FIX_NO_PLAN_CHANGES: preserve inline findings, repair/gather evidence under valid unchanged plan; REPLAN: concrete mechanism-invalidating evidence, fresh designated stronger planner, await PLAN_READY cheapgpt/plan.md, read replacement, implement; root may declare early REPLAN} CLOSE{one reviewer-triggered correction stage; at most two implementation reviews; final fresh reviewer: PASS or UNRESOLVED cheapgpt/plan.md; PASS: verify completion, clean board; UNRESOLVED: retain/read board, report blockers, stop cycle; another cycle requires new user instruction}

cheap.title: Cheap
cheap.planningMode: CHEAPGPT cheap. Apply the main prompt; reread cheapgpt/plan.md after context loss. Route line first (DIRECT/FOCUSED/FULL); escalate, never downgrade. Cycle: PLAN (core: acceptance list, mechanism; then handoffs) → BUILD (core path first; Terra dynamic: needs judgment; Luna mechanical: fully determined by the handoff, incl. tests; you integrate, check every step, write code only on DIRECT). Plan and build each: core review PASS/FIX/ESCALATE, terminal review PASS/UNRESOLVED. Failed repair or signal: revert, back to PLAN. UNRESOLVED: announce, new loop-breaker cycle now (fresh Sol xhigh replans); no significant advance or 2 such cycles → STEP BACK (big picture, back to the faulty step), then 2 cycles, then BLOCKED with EXPLORE/RESEARCH options. Native spawn/wait only; verify each child's model; never simulate or read a missing result as a pass. Delete board and temporary/ on PASS.
